name: @corbits-builder/publish
description: Shows where the project's app is published, with Publish and Take it down on the screen itself and in the conversation when the person asks there, records the person's go-ahead for each, and asks where to publish when more than one place is installed. It publishes nothing itself: a ready-made plan in the publish group does, such as publish-to-server.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person asks to publish their app or the changes they made to it, or to take it down. They give their go-ahead by pressing Publish or confirming Take it down, on the publish screen beside the plan or in the conversation; Builder then adds the work to the plan with their go-ahead and tells you, and you carry it out. When they ask in the conversation, put the work on the plan and Builder asks them there: to publish, add the ready-made publish plan they want, taking its earlier group out of the plan first when one is still there; to take it down, add the remove action of the place it is published at. If they decline, take that work out of the plan.
builder.unless: The project has no saved app yet, or the person only asks where or whether it is published, which publish.release records.

facts.agreed:publish: the person's go-ahead to publish by the chosen plan stands: they pressed Publish, on the publish screen or in the conversation, and the publish it allows has not gone out yet
